Pinta del color del borde las esquinas r: Paints the rounded corners (transparent or light) of the images with the border colour, so no white triangles show when bleeding or trimming. Off, they stay the colour of the paper.

2. Mira la hoja a contraluz: cada cruz r: 2. Hold the sheet up to the light: each red cross on the back should land in the centre of its slot.
3. Mide con la regla cuánto se desvía ca: 3. Use the ruler to measure how far each row is off (right and down are positive).
4. En «Alinear filas», pulsa «Corregir c: 4. In “Align rows”, click “Correct with measurements” and type them in.
Mirando la hoja de calibración al traslu: Holding the calibration sheet up to the light from the front, how far is each row's red cross off? Right and down are positive.
